optimizer.initialization: zero occurrence coefficients; occurrence solution used as count initialization where applicable

source_versions.observation_snapshot_note: The source snapshot mtime predates the frozen A3 development comparison; later source dates are not eligible for an untouched claim.

training_data_provenance.temporal_coverage: 2025-W01 through 2026-W29 response bundle; fit uses 2025-W01 through 2026-W16
training_data_provenance.spatial_extent: canonical model_node_id 0 through 10036 in revised-domain order
training_data_provenance.history_cutoff_rule: for forecast week t, only observations from weeks < t may be used

source_revision.historical_source_note: The historical generation and evaluation SHAs are preserved in the frozen artifact records; they are not required to be reachable from the release-facing entrypoint branch.

immutability_contract.change_rule: Changing an immutable field creates a separately identified challenger or new model version; it is not an edit to this freeze.

qualification_boundary.material_defect_rule: If qualification reveals a material model defect, this candidate fails qualification and any replacement is developed as a separately identified challenger/new version.
